title: PSG Champions League Win Triggers Nationwide Riots; 890 Detained
detail: Paris Saint-Germain defeated Arsenal on penalties in the Champions League final in Budapest, becoming back-to-back European champions. Celebrations in France rapidly turned violent: approximately 890 people were detained or questioned nationwide, with 283 arrested in Paris alone. Seven police officers were wounded; a man in his twenties died in a motorcycle crash during the unrest. Groups attempted to storm a police station in Paris's 8th Arrondissement and set cars ablaze near the Eiffel Tower. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez called the unrest 'absolutely unacceptable.' The episode reignited debate about France's ability to police large public gatherings and the social pressures concentrated in urban peripheries.

media.caption: Police deploy in Paris following violent clashes during PSG Champions League victory celebrations
